title: Rapid feedback digest + deploy asks (Feb 2025)
body:
Summary:
A compact digest of high-frequency customer feedback from Jan 15–Feb 5, 2025. Focused on requests that are small-to-medium engineering lift and have clear customer ROI if shipped quickly. This doc is intentionally prioritization-oriented: for each item we capture symptom, who reported it, suggested short-term workaround, and a recommended triage/owner for next steps.

Methodology:
- Sources: CS support tickets (tags: perf, embeddings, routing), recent CSM check-ins, partner calls, two in-product NPS comments, and one beta program survey.
- Filtering: kept items reported by >=3 distinct customers OR reported by 1 strategic customer with clear business impact.
- Confidence: frequency estimates are 'low/med/high' (back-of-envelope).

Top items (ordered by impact x ease):

1) Embedding consistency drift when model rolls (short sequences)
- Symptom: Search/retrieval results degrade after model version change; small docs move down results.
- Customers reporting (examples): legal-research startup (US), fintech analytics (EU), marketplace search pilot (APAC partner).
- Frequency: high
- Concrete ask: provide a versioned-embedding-migration guide + an opt-in compatibility mode that pins semantic hashing behavior for 30 days during model switchover.
- Suggested interim workaround: pin embedding model at client side (docs + snippet) and run a one-time re-embed; recommend a 2% token budget to reindex sample.
- Engineering estimate: small–medium (guide + endpoint flag; migration tool optional).
- Suggested owner: product-hosted-api + applied-ml liaison
- Questions: can we detect and warn customers automatically when vector drift exceeds threshold? (ops/alerting effort)

2) Route fallback causes doubled latency for multipart requests
- Symptom: when primary model capacity exhausted, fallback to larger model triggers sequential rerun for multi-chunk requests; latency spikes reported.
- Customers: two mid-market SaaS (analytics) and one enterprise proof-of-concept.
- Frequency: medium
- Concrete ask: implement parallel-fallback logic for streaming multipart requests or a token-budgeted precheck that chooses fallback before request start.
- Interim workaround: cap concurrent multipart requests via per-route quota and increase dedicated capacity during peak windows.
- Engineering estimate: medium (runtime + routing change).
- Owner: serving-runtime + platform-engineering
- Notes: prioritize for dedicated customers with SLA impacts.

3) Cost visibility granularity: per-request token breakdown missing for multi-tool calls
- Symptom: billing analytics show aggregate tokens but not which tools/functions consumed tokens in complex flows. Hard for customers to optimize.
- Customers: three platform teams (one enterprise), two growth customers.
- Frequency: high
- Ask: add per-invocation token attribution to Console logs and expose in billing export (CSV/JSON).
- Interim: provide best-effort estimation script (python) customers can run on sample traces.
- Estimate: small (console + export schema change).
- Owner: console-and-rollouts + observability

4) Private deployment onboarding: unclear KMS key rotation steps
- Symptom: customers on Private/VPC worry about how to rotate keys without downtime; docs sparse.
- Customers: two regulated customers prepping SOC2 + one pre-sale evaluation.
- Frequency: low (but high severity for those customers)
- Ask: publish a step-by-step KMS rotation runbook and add an automated key-rotation helper script for on-prem packages.
- Interim workaround: manual walkthrough with SE (already happening).
- Estimate: small (docs + script).
- Owner: private-deployments + solutions-engineering

5) Model catalog search is noisy for 'cost-optimized' tag
- Symptom: devs can't reliably find models that trade quality for cost; tag results include incompatible architectures.
- Customers: frequent ask in onboarding sessions and forum threads.
- Frequency: high
- Ask: improve search facets for model catalog: add filters for 'sequence-length-optimized', 'quantization-friendly', and verified cost-per-token ranges.
- Interim: curated FAQ list in Console and quick recommendations in onboarding email.
- Estimate: small–medium (catalog + console UI)
- Owner: product-hosted-api + developer-experience

6) Logs retention mismatch between Console and Audit export
- Symptom: console shows 90 days retention but audit export API returns only 30 days for some plans. Customers confused during audits.
- Customers: one enterprise legal customer (audit preparation), one platform team.
- Frequency: medium
- Ask: reconcile docs and exports; if policy differs by plan, make retention explicit per org in Console.
- Interim: manual CSV pull on request by CS.
- Estimate: small (docs + API change if needed)
- Owner: observability + product-ops

Open curiosities / low-signal items (monitor before committing):
- Feature requests for 'interactive prompt playground with saved diffs' (several UX-y asks but low firm commitment)
- A single customer asked for an 'escape hatch' to turn off prefix caching per-request for debugging — tiny but useful for dev tools.

Customer quotes (unedited snippets):
- "After the model swap our search relevancy dropped — took us a week to track down that embeddings changed. Need migration help." — Platform eng lead, fintech
- "Fallbacking to a larger model doubled our latency and timed out one job; we can't afford that for real-time analytics." — Data infra PM, analytics startup

Immediate next steps (owner checkpoints):
- Product: pick top 3 items to scope for Q2 rapid wins (recommended: embedding migration guide, cost visibility export, model catalog facets). Due: 2025-02-25.
- Eng leads: quick feasibility notes in PRD sketch (1 page) by 2025-02-21.
- CS/SEs: prepare customer communication templates for interim workarounds (sending today).
- Ops: run detection spike experiment to see how often fallback is invoked across top 50 tenants (data pull by 2025-02-20).

Unresolved questions for leadership:
- Do we want an official SLA uplift for customers who purchase 'dedicated fallback' capacity? (pricing/packaging needed)
- Is automated drift-detection (for embeddings) something we prototype in Q2, or reserve for Optimize product?

Appendix: quick scripts & links
- Estimation script for token attribution: github.com/redwood/tools/token-attrib-sample (SE draft)
- Draft embedding migration checklist PR: github.com/redwood/product/prs/emb-migrate-9
- Slack thread: #cs-embedding-notice (pinned notes)

Notes to self / CS authoring crumbs:
- When pushing interim workaround to customers, include 'how to test' checklist and a rollback step.
- Track which items get moved to product roadmap vs. tactical fixes — add a column in the weekly CS spreadsheet.

If this doc looks good, I'll convert top-3 sections into two-pager PRD sketches and loop in Eng leads for estimates.

-- Aisha (CS)
